issues.failure_explanation: The integrand is evaluated along a trajectory depending on the input or terminal state. Comparing two averages therefore requires a bound on the separation of those trajectories, not merely Lip(v_τ). issues.failure_explanation: Trace-class C is bounded, so C^(1/2) restricts to a globally Lipschitz map H→H. More strongly, the allowed choice λ_k = k^(−2s) gives ||C^(1/2)x||_H = ||x||_(H^(−s)), making the stated white-to-colored pushforward a Lipschitz map from the actual noise space into H. The fact that white noise is not an H-valued input law is a domain issue; it does not establish nonregularity of the transport or an obstruction caused by mutual singularity itself.
